
# Load packages
```{r}
library(readr)
library(xfun)
```



Euler et al., 2014 sent raw data and codes in .txt. Need to construct matrices from raw data.

# Euler et al., 2014
```{r}
##  
file_paths <- list.files(path = "Raw data/data in different format/Euler et al 2014", 
                         pattern = "12a\\.txt$", 
                         full.names = TRUE) 
readLines(file_paths[1], warn = FALSE)
```



## fix deprecated function
as.real() in R has been deprecated, replace it with Re(). This code fix it in the original files.

```{r}


for (i in 1:length(file_paths)) {
  script <- readLines(file_paths[i])
  
  if (any(grepl("as.real", script, fixed = TRUE))) {
    xfun::gsub_files(file_paths[i], "as\\.real", "Re")} 
  else {message("No as.real found in", file_paths[i])}
}




```
